beaconsoftware-beaconsoftware:ashbyhq:f0.title: Product Manager
beaconsoftware-beaconsoftware:ashbyhq:f0.description: Beacon https://beaconsoftware.com is building the essential technology infrastructure for the everyday economy: the businesses, organizations, and services that make real life work, and that mainstream tech has largely left behind. We acquire, operate, and grow vertical market software companies. They are niche, founder-built businesses serving industries that are often overlooked and too profitable to ignore. Our model is simple: we seek out founders who have built their business by spending years understanding their market and prioritizing their customers' specific needs. We buy great businesses, invest in their continued growth, and hold them permanently, accelerating that growth with an AI-native platform built specifically for vertical market software. No mandate to cut, flip, or roll up into something unrecognizable. We are not a financial firm. We are technology entrepreneurs and operators who believe the most important businesses in the world are already running quietly in industries most people never think about. Our job is to find them, support the people who built them, and make them better. Beacon is backed by a diverse base of investors, with $550M+ raised to date, including General Catalyst, Lightspeed, D1 Capital, CPMG, the family offices of the founders of Stripe, DoorDash, and Ramp, and evergreen funds built for the long game. ABOUT THE ROLE You'll be joining Beacon's Portfolio Product team, a cross-functional group of Product Managers, Engineers, Designers, GTM experts, and Data Scientists. We work directly with our 30+ portfolio companies, businesses we're acquiring at roughly one per week, to drive measurable outcomes through AI and software. As a Product Manager, you'll own product outcomes for 3-4 portfolio companies at a time. You'll sit close to the GM, the operators, and the customers, figuring out where the leverage is and shipping software directly into their business. The best PMs in this role won't just deliver for the companies they're deployed at. They'll compress what they learned into reusable playbooks that ship to every other portfolio company in the same vertical. This is not a consulting role. We ship software, not slides. The deliverable is a running system. Key Responsibilities - Own product outcomes for 3-4 portfolio companies simultaneously, acting as a fractional product leader embedded in each business - Lead quarterly and annual planning, helping teams set product visions and translate them into achievable goals - Build and maintain roadmaps that balance customer needs, business goals, and technical constraints - Drive sprint planning and execution, improving team velocity and predictability over time - Develop prioritization frameworks that help CEOs and operators make better product decisions - Build customer feedback systems that turn qualitative inputs into actionable roadmap decisions - Coordinate feature launches across engineering, sales, marketing, and support - Coach developers, designers, and early PMs to think like product managers - Distill learnings into cross-portfolio playbooks that scale impact beyond your assigned companies What We're Looking For - BA/BS Degree - 4+ years of product management experience, ideally in B2B SaaS - Strong fundamentals: roadmapping, sprint planning, spec writing, prioritization frameworks - Sharp customer discovery instincts and ability to identify high-impact opportunities fast - Comfortable managing multiple companies and stakeholders simultaneously - Ability to influence founders and executives without direct authority - High autonomy, low ego. You figure things out and get them done - Entrepreneurial mindset and genuine comfort with ambiguity This role is perfect for you if... - You are an ex-founder or want to start your own B2B SaaS company one day - You want real exposure to how profitable businesses are built and scaled across multiple industries - You get more satisfaction from building capability in others than shipping features

getwingapp-getwingapp:lever:d248273b-80a.description: At Wing, we give growing businesses access to the top tier of global remote talent supercharged by AI so they can scale without scaling headcount. From sales and support to operations and admin, Wing turns the recurring work that bogs teams down into reliable, AI-powered capacity that drives real output. Trusted by 1000’s businesses and powered by a global talent pool and our proprietary Wing AI platform, we help startups, SMBs, and enterprises move faster and do more with less. Our growth is fueled by hiring exceptional people, holding them to high standards, and giving them room to make an impact. If you’re hungry for growth and ready to get to work, you won’t find a better place to learn and accelerate your career. What You’ll Do Prospect, educate, and qualify leads to create sales-ready opportunities and serve as the first point of contact for prospects evaluating Wing. Run high-volume, multi-channel outbound (calls, email, LinkedIn, events) and make strategic outbound touches daily to build pipeline and exceed meeting and SQL targets. Tailor outreach to each prospect’s goals and business model; master the Wing story and articulate our value in offloading repetitive work, scaling teams affordably, and increasing capacity and revenue. Partner with Account Executives to schedule calls, meetings, and demos, and ensure smooth handoffs that convert into opportunities and closed-won deals. Conduct discovery to qualify fit, pain, and timing; map stakeholders across Operations, Marketing, and Executive teams. Acquire key prospect data from the initial conversation, the web, and other sources; keep clean, accurate, up-to-date records in the CRM. Proactively stay current on the AI, staffing, and outsourcing landscape, and share market feedback with Sales, Marketing, and Product to sharpen messaging and cadences. Achieve or exceed monthly quotas of qualified appointments, scheduled demos, and pipeline generated. What You’ll Bring 6 months–2 years of outbound sales experience (SDR, BDR, D2D, inside sales, or similar). (Adjust up to 1–3 years for a more senior bar.) Confidence on the phone and in writing you can articulate value whether it’s a 30-second cold call or a personalized email. A reliable home/remote work setup and the self-discipline to run a high-volume desk without an office around you. Comfort with high volume; you can run 50+ touches a day without sacrificing quality. CRM discipline: clean data, updated stages, notes your AEs can actually use. Strong work ethic, competitiveness with yourself, and an eagerness to learn you track your numbers, know your conversion rates, and treat every “no” as a signal about messaging, timing, or targeting. Nice to have: experience selling AI, SaaS, or staffing/BPO/outsourced services. Logistics Fully remote. Pacific Time/ Eastern Time 4-year degree preferred but not required. Why You’ll Love Working Here Wing is one of the best places to: Join the leaders in AI-powered remote work Unlock career-defining growth on a fast-scaling team Build alongside world-class talent, fully remote Make a real, measurable impact on the businesses we serve

jobgether-jobgether:lever:32b90111-6d3b-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Sales Manager B2B based in France. This is a high-impact opportunity to help build a new B2B vertical within a fast-growing performance-driven business focused on the U.S. home services market. You’ll take ownership of developing a strong network of contractors and lead buyers, from prospecting through negotiation and contract closure. The role combines hands-on business development with the opportunity to build scalable sales processes and partnership systems from the ground up. You’ll use data and performance metrics to evaluate opportunities, optimize partner relationships, and drive measurable commercial results. Beyond sales, you’ll contribute to B2B brand building through targeted content, online initiatives, industry research, and potentially U.S. conferences. You’ll operate with a high degree of autonomy in a lean team where initiative, accountability, and measurable impact are highly valued. For strong senior contributors, the role also offers the opportunity to participate in a shares program and grow alongside the success of the new business vertical. Build and develop a high-quality network of contractors and lead buyers across the U.S. home services and home improvement markets. Independently identify and qualify prospective B2B partners through research, outbound prospecting, networking, and other lead-generation activities. Conduct discovery and demo calls with potential partners, manage negotiations, and drive qualified opportunities through to signed agreements. Develop and maintain long-term relationships with partners, ensuring consistent communication and strong commercial performance. Collect and analyze partner feedback on lead quality, appointment rates, close rates, and other relevant performance indicators. Use data and performance metrics to identify opportunities, improve partner outcomes, and inform commercial decisions. Contribute to the development of the B2B brand through targeted partner-facing content, online activities, and initiatives designed to generate new partnerships. Research the U.S. home services market, identify new opportunities, and continuously develop ideas for improving the sales and partnership strategy. Build and automate sales and partnership processes to create scalable systems rather than relying solely on manual execution. Plan and execute initiatives independently, from initial research and ideation through implementation, measurement, and optimization. Represent the business at relevant industry conferences and events in the U.S. when appropriate, with a focus on developing valuable commercial relationships. Collaborate with internal stakeholders to align partnership acquisition, lead quality, commercial objectives, and overall business performance. Requirements: 2+ years of professional experience in B2B Sales, Business Development, or a closely related commercial role, with demonstrated experience prospecting and closing deals. 2+ years of experience in Home Services or Home Improvement, with a strong understanding of contractors, lead buyers, and the dynamics of lead-based business models. Demonstrated ability to independently generate leads, conduct sales conversations, negotiate, and close B2B partnerships. Practical experience automating sales or business processes, with the ability to build repeatable systems rather than simply execute individual tasks. Strong data-driven mindset and analytical skills, with the ability to make commercial decisions based on performance metrics and evidence. Proven track record of strong professional results, supported by specific measurable achievements and commercial outcomes. Highly structured approach to work, with the ability to maintain attention to detail while understanding the broader business picture. jobgether-jobgether:lever:96739a52-a314-.title: Google Cloud Delivery Architect
jobgether-jobgether:lever:96739a52-a314-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Google Cloud Delivery Architect based in Italy. This is a senior, hands-on cloud architecture role focused on delivering complex Google Cloud engagements from design through implementation and handover. You will take ownership of scoped, fixed-budget projects and translate customer requirements into reliable production environments. The role combines cloud architecture, infrastructure as code, Kubernetes, networking, security, and DevOps expertise. You will work directly with customers, lead technical discussions, and manage several engagements in parallel. You’ll also drive cloud migrations, establish secure landing zones, and modernize infrastructure through automation and GitOps. This is an opportunity to make a direct impact on enterprise cloud transformation while operating with significant technical and delivery ownership. Own the end-to-end delivery of Google Cloud engagements, from low-level design and implementation through validation, documentation, knowledge transfer, and final handover. Design and execute cloud migrations from AWS or Azure to Google Cloud, including production workloads such as EKS to GKE, RDS to Cloud SQL, and S3 to Cloud Storage. Design and implement secure Google Cloud foundations and landing zones covering resource hierarchies, IAM, organization policies, networking, and security controls, with infrastructure codified in Terraform. Architect and deploy production-grade GKE environments, including private clusters, node pools, Workload Identity, Helm-based add-ons, ingress, autoscaling, and Cloud Armor. Enable DevOps and infrastructure automation by importing existing environments into Terraform, developing reusable modules, and implementing CI/CD and GitOps workflows using tools such as GitHub Actions and Argo CD. Manage multiple customer engagements simultaneously, maintaining delivery plans, project hours, scope, budgets, and timelines while identifying risks and budget deviations early. Lead customer-facing workshops, weekly meetings, technical discussions, and handover sessions with engineering teams, technical leaders, and CTO-level stakeholders. Protect project scope through effective change management and ensure that all delivered environments are supported by clear documentation, runbooks, and knowledge transfer. Apply AI-assisted development tools thoughtfully in architecture, implementation, troubleshooting, and delivery workflows while maintaining strong technical judgment and quality standards. Requirements 5+ years of hands-on cloud infrastructure and architecture experience, with deep production experience specifically in Google Cloud. Strong expertise in Terraform, including reusable and modular infrastructure code, remote state management, and importing manually provisioned environments. Proven production experience with Kubernetes and GKE, including private clusters, node pools, autoscaling, RBAC, Workload Identity, Helm, and ingress. Strong knowledge of Google Cloud networking and security, including VPC architecture, Cloud NAT, DNS, VPN, Private Service Connect, firewall policies, IAM, Organization Policies, and Secret Manager. Practical experience with CI/CD and DevOps practices, including GitHub Actions or equivalent, keyless authentication to Google Cloud, container workflows, and GitOps with Argo CD or similar tools. Working knowledge of AWS or Azure, with the ability to understand and assess source-cloud environments as part of migration projects. Strong customer-facing English communication skills, with confidence leading technical workshops, weekly meetings, presentations, and handovers. Demonstrated ability to manage multiple technical engagements, work within defined budgets and scopes, and take ownership of delivery outcomes. Strong architectural thinking, problem-solving ability, documentation skills, and attention to implementation qual
